title.en: Table of Marquises by Grace of Imperial Relatives

sentences.zh: 自古受命及中興之君，必興滅繼絕，修廢舉逸，然後天下歸仁，四方之政行焉。

translations.literal: Since ancient times, rulers who received the Mandate and those who restored their dynasties invariably revived fallen states, continued severed lines, restored what had been abandoned, and elevated the overlooked. Only then did the realm return to benevolence and governance reach to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, every ruler who received the Mandate and every sovereign who restored a dynasty invariably revived the fallen, continued the severed, restored the neglected, and elevated the overlooked. Only then did the realm embrace benevolence and governance extend to every quarter.

sentences.zh: 傳稱武王克殷，追存賢聖，至乎不及下車。

translations.literal: The tradition states that when King Wu conquered the Yin, he sought out and honored the worthy and sagely to such an extent that he did not even have time to dismount from his chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Tradition holds that when King Wu conquered the Yin, he sought out and honored the worthy and sage with such urgency that he did not even pause to dismount from his chariot.

sentences.zh: 世代雖殊，其揆一也。

translations.literal: Though the ages differ, the guiding principle is one and the same.
translations.idiomatic: Though the ages differ, the guiding principle remains the same.

sentences.zh: 高帝撥亂誅暴，庶事草創，日不暇給，然猶修祀六國，求聘四皓，過魏則寵無忌之墓，適趙則封樂毅之後。

translations.literal: Emperor Gao set the disordered age aright and punished the violent. With all affairs still in their early stages and days never long enough, he nonetheless restored the sacrifices of the Six States, sought out and invited the Four White-Haired Elders, honored the tomb of Lord Wuji when passing through Wei, and enfeoffed the descendants of Yue Yi when visiting Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gao set the disordered age aright and punished the violent. Though all affairs were still in their infancy and the days never long enough, he restored the sacrifices of the Six States, sought out the Four White-Haired Elders, honored Lord Wuji's tomb when passing through Wei, and enfeoffed Yue Yi's descendants when visiting Zhao.

sentences.zh: 及其行賞而授位也，爵以功為先後，官用能為次序。

translations.literal: When it came to dispensing rewards and bestowing positions, noble rank followed the order of merit, and official appointment followed the order of ability.
translations.idiomatic: In dispensing rewards and bestowing positions, noble rank followed the order of merit, and office followed the order of ability.

sentences.zh: 後嗣共己遵業，舊臣繼踵居位。

translations.literal: His successors reverently adhered to his achievements, and the old ministers followed one another in holding office.
translations.idiomatic: His successors reverently upheld his legacy, and the old ministers followed one upon another in their posts.

sentences.zh: 至乎孝武，元功宿將略盡。

translations.literal: By the time of Emperor Wu, the founding meritorious officials and veteran generals had nearly all passed away.
translations.idiomatic: By the reign of Emperor Wu, the founding officials and veteran generals had nearly all passed away.

sentences.zh: 會上亦興文學，進拔幽隱，公孫弘自海瀕而登宰相，於是寵以列侯之爵。

translations.literal: It happened that the emperor also promoted literary learning and elevated the obscure and hidden. Gongsun Hong rose from the shores of the sea to become chancellor, and was thereupon honored with the rank of a ranked marquis.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also promoted literary learning and elevated those dwelling in obscurity. Gongsun Hong rose from the shores of the sea to become chancellor and was honored with the rank of a ranked marquis.

sentences.zh: 又疇咨前代，詢問耆老，初得周後，復加爵邑。

translations.literal: He also consulted the records of former ages and inquired of the elders; having first found descendants of the Zhou, he further bestowed upon them noble rank and fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: He also consulted the records of former ages and questioned the elders. Having found descendants of the Zhou, he bestowed upon them noble rank and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 自是之後，宰相畢侯矣。

translations.literal: From this time onward, every chancellor was enfeoffed as a marquis.
translations.idiomatic: From this time onward, every chancellor was made a marquis.

sentences.zh: 元、成之間，晚得殷世，以備賓位。

translations.literal: Between the reigns of Emperors Yuan and Cheng, descendants of the Yin were at last found and installed in the guest position.
translations.idiomatic: Between the reigns of Emperors Yuan and Cheng, descendants of the Yin were at last located and installed in the guest position.

sentences.zh: 漢興，外戚與定天下，侯者二人。

translations.literal: When the Han arose, two imperial relatives by marriage helped settle the realm and were made marquises.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han dynasty arose, two imperial relatives by marriage helped pacify the realm and were made marquises.

sentences.zh: 故誓曰：「非劉氏不王，若有亡功非上所置而侯者，天下共誅之。」

translations.literal: Therefore the oath stated: 'None but the Liu clan shall be made king. Should anyone without merit or not appointed by the emperor be made a marquis, all under heaven shall join in punishing him.'
translations.idiomatic: Hence the sworn covenant declared: 'None but the Liu clan shall be made king. Should anyone without merit or not appointed by the emperor be enfeoffed as marquis, all under heaven shall join in punishing him.'

sentences.zh: 是以高后欲王諸呂，王陵廷爭；

translations.literal: For this reason, when Empress Dowager Gao wished to make the Lü clan kings, Wang Ling argued against it at court;
translations.idiomatic: For this reason, when Empress Dowager Gao wished to make the Lü clan kings, Wang Ling openly opposed her in court;

sentences.zh: 孝景將侯王氏，脩侯犯色。

translations.literal: when Emperor Jing was about to enfeoff the Wang clan, the Marquis of Xiu defied him with his expression.
translations.idiomatic: and when Emperor Jing was about to enfeoff the Wang clan, the Marquis of Xiu showed his displeasure openly.

sentences.zh: 卒用廢黜。

translations.literal: In the end, [those plans] were abandoned and set aside.
translations.idiomatic: In the end, both schemes were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 是後薄昭、竇嬰、上官、衛、霍之侯，以功受爵。

translations.literal: After this, the marquessates of Bo Zhao, Dou Ying, Shangguan, Wei, and Huo were received through merit.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, the marquessates of Bo Zhao, Dou Ying, and the Shangguan, Wei, and Huo clans were conferred on the basis of merit.

sentences.zh: 其餘后父據□秋褒紀之義，帝舅緣大雅申伯之意，寖廣博矣。

translations.literal: The rest — the empress's father was honored based on the Spring and Autumn principle of praising the Ji clan; the emperor's maternal uncle drew on the Greater Odes' ideal of Duke Shen — and the practice gradually broadened and expanded.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining enfeoffments were justified by the Spring and Autumn principle of honoring the empress's father, and the Greater Odes' ideal for the emperor's maternal uncle. The practice grew ever broader.

sentences.zh: 是以別而敘之。

translations.literal: Therefore I have set them apart and narrated them separately.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason, I have separated them out and narrated them apart.

sentences.zh: 號諡姓名

translations.literal: Title, posthumous name, surname, and personal name.
translations.idiomatic: Title, posthumous name, surname, and personal name.

sentences.zh: 侯狀戶數

translations.literal: Circumstances of enfeoffment and number of households.
translations.idiomatic: Circumstances of enfeoffment and household count.

sentences.zh: 始封

translations.literal: Initial enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Initial enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 子

translations.literal: Son.
translations.idiomatic: Son.

sentences.zh: 孫

translations.literal: Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Grandson.

sentences.zh: 曾孫

translations.literal: Great-grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Great-grandson.

sentences.zh: 玄孫

translations.literal: Great-great-grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Great-great-grandson.

cells.content: 臨泗侯呂公
cells.literal: Linsi Marquis Lü Gong
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Linsi: Lord Lü

cells.content: 以漢王后父賜號。
cells.literal: Because Han empress's father, title bestowed.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as father of the Han empress; the title was bestowed.

cells.content: 元年封，四年薨，高后元年追尊曰呂宣王。
cells.literal: First year enfeoffed, fourth year died, Empress Dowager Gao first year posthumously honored as King Lü Xuan.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed in the first year; died in the fourth year. In the first year of Empress Dowager Gao he was posthumously honored as King Lü Xuan.

cells.content: 周呂令武侯澤
cells.literal: Zhoulü Lingwu Marquis Ze
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Lingwu of Zhoulü: Ze

cells.content: 以客從入漢，定三秦，將兵下碭，漢王敗彭城，往從之，佐定天下。
cells.literal: As guest followed entering Han, settled Three Qin, led troops down Dang, Han King defeated at Pengcheng, went to follow him, assisted settling realm.
cells.idiomatic: As a guest he followed into Han, helped pacify the Three Qin, led troops down to Dang, and when the King of Han was defeated at Pengcheng went to join him and helped settle the realm.

cells.content: 六年正月丙戌封，三年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth year first month bingxu day enfeoffed, three years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingxu day of the first month in the sixth year; died after three years.

cells.content: 侯台嗣，高祖九年更封為鄜侯，四年，高后元年，為呂王，二年薨，諡曰肅，追尊令武曰悼武王。
cells.literal: Marquis Tai succeeded, Emperor Gao ninth year again enfeoffed as Fu Marquis, four years, Empress Dowager Gao first year, became Lü King, two years died, posthumous name Su, posthumously honored Lingwu as King Lü Dao.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Tai succeeded him. In the ninth year of Emperor Gao he was re-enfeoffed as Marquis of Fu; in the fourth year, in the first year of Empress Dowager Gao, he became King of Lü and died after two years, posthumous name Su. Marquis Lingwu was posthumously honored as King Lü Dao.

cells.content: 腄三年，王嘉嗣，坐驕廢。侯通，嘉弟，六年四月丁酉封，八年，為燕王，九月，反，誅。
cells.literal: Zan third year, Wang Jia succeeded, sat arrogance dismissed. Marquis Tong, Jia younger brother, sixth year fourth month dingyou day enfeoffed, eighth year, became Yan King, ninth month, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: In the third year, Wang Jia succeeded and was dismissed for arrogance. Marquis Tong, Jia's younger brother, was enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the fourth month in the sixth year; in the eighth year he became King of Yan; in the ninth month he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 東平侯庀，通弟，八年五月丙辰封，九月，反，誅。
cells.literal: Dongping Marquis Pi, Tong younger brother, eighth year fifth month bingchen day enfeoffed, ninth month, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Dongping: Pi, Tong's younger brother. Enfeoffed on the bingchen day of the fifth month in the eighth year; in the ninth month he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 汶侯產，台弟，高后元年四月辛卯封，六年，為呂王，七年，為梁王，八年，反，誅。
cells.literal: Wen Marquis Chan, Tai younger brother, Empress Dowager Gao first year fourth month xinmao day enfeoffed, sixth year, became Lü King, seventh year, became Liang King, eighth year, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Wen: Chan, Tai's younger brother. Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the fourth month in the first year of Empress Dowager Gao; in the sixth year he became King of Lü, in the seventh year King of Liang; in the eighth year he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 建成康侯釋之
cells.literal: Jiancheng Kang Marquis Shizhi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Kang of Jiancheng: Shizhi

cells.content: 以客從擊秦。漢王入漢，使釋之歸豐衛太上皇。
cells.literal: As guest followed attacking Qin. Han King entered Han, sent Shizhi return Feng guard Grand Supreme Emperor.
cells.idiomatic: As a guest he followed in the attack on Qin. When the King of Han entered Han he sent Shizhi back to Feng to guard the Grand Supreme Emperor.

cells.content: 六年四月丙戌封，九年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth year fourth month bingxu day enfeoffed, nine years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingxu day of the fourth month in the sixth year; died after nine years.

cells.content: 孝惠二年，侯則嗣，七年，有罪，免。則弟種，高后元年四月乙酉封，奉呂宣王國，七年，更為不其侯，八年，反，誅。
cells.literal: Emperor Hui second year, Marquis Ze succeeded, seventh year, had crime, dismissed. Ze younger brother Zhong, Empress Dowager Gao first year fourth month yiyou day enfeoffed, attended Lü Xuan King state, seventh year, again became Buqi Marquis, eighth year, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: In the second year of Emperor Hui, Marquis Ze succeeded; in the seventh year he was guilty of a crime and dismissed. Ze's younger brother Zhong was enfeoffed on the yiyou day of the fourth month in the first year of Empress Dowager Gao, attended the state of King Lü Xuan; in the seventh year he was changed to Marquis of Buqi; in the eighth year he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 漢陽侯祿，種弟，高后元年九月丙寅封，八年，為趙王，追尊康侯曰趙昭王，九月，反，誅。
cells.literal: Hanyang Marquis Lu, Zhong younger brother, Empress Dowager Gao first year ninth month bingyin day enfeoffed, eighth year, became Zhao King, posthumously honored Kang Marquis as Zhao Zhao King, ninth month, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Hanyang: Lu, Zhong's younger brother. Enfeoffed on the bingyin day of the ninth month in the first year of Empress Dowager Gao; in the eighth year he became King of Zhao, and Marquis Kang was posthumously honored as King Zhao Zhao; in the ninth month he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 扶柳侯呂平
cells.literal: Fufu Marquis Lü Ping
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Fufu: Lü Ping

cells.content: 以皇太后姊長姁子侯。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager elder sister Chang Xu son marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as son of the empress dowager's elder sister Chang Xu.

cells.content: 元年四月丙寅封，八年，反，誅。
cells.literal: First year fourth month bingyin day enfeoffed, eighth year, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingyin day of the fourth month in the first year; in the eighth year he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 襄城侯義
cells.literal: Xiangcheng Marquis Yi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Xiangcheng: Yi

cells.content: 以孝惠子侯。
cells.literal: Because Emperor Hui son marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as a son of Emperor Hui.

cells.content: 四月辛卯封，三年，為常山王。
cells.literal: Fourth month xinmao day enfeoffed, third year, became Changshan King.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the fourth month; in the third year he became King of Changshan.

cells.content: 軹侯朝
cells.literal: Zhi Marquis Chao
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Zhi: Chao

cells.content: 以孝惠子侯。
cells.literal: Because Emperor Hui son marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as a son of Emperor Hui.

cells.content: 四月辛卯封，四年，為常山王。
cells.literal: Fourth month xinmao day enfeoffed, fourth year, became Changshan King.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the fourth month; in the fourth year he became King of Changshan.

cells.content: 壺關侯武
cells.literal: Huguan Marquis Wu
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Huguan: Wu

cells.content: 以孝惠子侯。
cells.literal: Because Emperor Hui son marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as a son of Emperor Hui.

cells.content: 四月辛卯封，六年，為淮陽王。
cells.literal: Fourth month xinmao day enfeoffed, sixth year, became Huaiyang King.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the fourth month; in the sixth year he became King of Huaiyang.

cells.content: 昌平侯大
cells.literal: Changping Marquis Da
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Changping: Da

cells.content: 以孝惠子侯。
cells.literal: Because Emperor Hui son marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as a son of Emperor Hui.

cells.content: 二月癸未封，七年，為呂王。
cells.literal: Second month guiwei day enfeoffed, seventh year, became Lü King.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the guiwei day of the second month; in the seventh year he became King of Lü.

cells.content: 贅其侯呂勝
cells.literal: Zhuiqi Marquis Lü Sheng
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Zhuiqi: Lü Sheng

cells.content: 以皇太后昆弟子淮陽丞相侯。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager uterine younger brother Huaiyang chancellor marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as uterine younger brother of the empress dowager and chancellor of Huaiyang.

cells.content: 四月丙申封，八年，反，誅。
cells.literal: Fourth month bingshen day enfeoffed, eighth year, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingshen day of the fourth month; in the eighth year he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 滕侯呂更始
cells.literal: Teng Marquis Lü Gengshi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Teng: Lü Gengshi

cells.content: 為舍人郎中十二歲，以都尉屯霸上，用楚丞相侯。
cells.literal: Was attendant gentleman twelve years, as commandant garrisoned Bashang, used Chu chancellor marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Served as attendant and gentleman for twelve years; as commandant he garrisoned Bashang and was made marquis for his service as chancellor of Chu.

cells.content: 四月丙申封，八年，反，誅。
cells.literal: Fourth month bingshen day enfeoffed, eighth year, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingshen day of the fourth month; in the eighth year he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 呂成侯呂忿
cells.literal: Lücheng Marquis Lü Fen
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Lücheng: Lü Fen

cells.content: 以皇太后昆弟子侯。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager uterine younger brother marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as uterine younger brother of the empress dowager.

cells.content: 四月丙申封，八年，反，誅。
cells.literal: Fourth month bingshen day enfeoffed, eighth year, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingshen day of the fourth month; in the eighth year he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 祝茲侯呂瑩
cells.literal: Zhuzi Marquis Lü Ying
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Zhuzi: Lü Ying

cells.content: 以皇太后昆弟子侯。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager uterine younger brother marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as uterine younger brother of the empress dowager.

cells.content: 八年四月丁酉封，九月，反，誅。
cells.literal: Eighth year fourth month dingyou day enfeoffed, ninth month, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the fourth month in the eighth year; in the ninth month he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 建陵侯張釋寺人
cells.literal: Jianling Marquis Zhang Shi eunuch
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Jianling: Zhang Shi the eunuch

cells.content: 以大謁者勸王諸呂侯。
cells.literal: As grand usher urged kings against various Lü, marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As grand usher he urged the kings against the various Lü and was made marquis.

cells.content: 四月丁酉封，九月，免。
cells.literal: Fourth month dingyou day enfeoffed, ninth month, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the fourth month; in the ninth month he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 右高后十人。

translations.literal: Above: ten persons under Empress Dowager Gao.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists ten persons enfeoffed under Empress Dowager Gao.

sentences.zh: 五人隨父，凡十五人。

translations.literal: Five persons listed with their fathers. In total, fifteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Five are listed with their fathers, for a total of fifteen persons.

cells.content: 章武景侯竇廣國
cells.literal: Zhangwu Jing Marquis Dou Guangguo
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Zhangwu: Dou Guangguo

cells.content: 以皇太后弟侯，萬一千戶。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager younger brother marquis, ten thousand one thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as younger brother of the empress dowager, with 11,000 households.

cells.content: 孝文後七年六月乙卯封，七年薨。
cells.literal: Emperor Wen after seventh year sixth month yimao day enfeoffed, seven years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yimao day of the sixth month in the seventh year after Emperor Wen; died after seven years.

cells.content: 孝景七年，共侯定嗣，十八年薨。
cells.literal: Emperor Jing seventh year, Gong Marquis Ding succeeded, eighteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Emperor Jing, Marquis Gong Ding succeeded him and died after eighteen years.

cells.content: 元光三年，侯常生嗣，十年，元狩元年，坐謀殺人，未殺，免。
cells.literal: Yuanguang third year, Marquis Changsheng succeeded, ten years, Yuanshou first year, sat plotting kill person, not killed, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanguang, Marquis Changsheng succeeded him. After ten years, in the first year of Yuanshou, he was convicted of plotting to kill a man though the man was not killed, and was dismissed.

cells.content: 南皮侯竇彭祖
cells.literal: Nanpi Marquis Dou Pengzu
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Nanpi: Dou Pengzu

cells.content: 以皇太后兄子侯。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager elder brother's son marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as son of the empress dowager's elder brother.

cells.content: 六月乙卯封，二十一年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth month yimao day enfeoffed, twenty-one years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yimao day of the sixth month; died after twenty-one years.

cells.content: 建元六年，夷侯良嗣，五年薨。
cells.literal: Jianyuan sixth year, Yi Marquis Liang succeeded, five years died.
cells.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jianyuan, Yi Marquis Liang succeeded him and died after five years.

cells.content: 元光五年，侯桑林嗣，十八年，元鼎五年，坐酎金免。
cells.literal: Yuanguang fifth year, Marquis Sanglin succeeded, eighteen years, Yuanding fifth year, sat tribute wine deficiency dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yuanguang, Marquis Sanglin succeeded him. After eighteen years, in the fifth year of Yuanding, he was convicted of tribute wine deficiency and dismissed.

cells.content: 魏其侯竇嬰
cells.literal: Weiqi Marquis Dou Ying
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Weiqi: Dou Ying

cells.content: 以將軍屯滎陽扞破吳楚七國侯。皇太后昆弟子。
cells.literal: As general garrisoned Xingyang repelled defeated Wu Chu seven states marquis. Empress dowager uterine younger brother.
cells.idiomatic: As a general he garrisoned Xingyang, repelled and defeated the seven states of Wu and Chu, and was made marquis. Uterine younger brother of the empress dowager.

cells.content: 三年六月乙巳封，二十三年，元光四年，有罪，棄市。
cells.literal: Third year sixth month yisi day enfeoffed, twenty-three years, Yuanguang fourth year, had crime, executed in marketplace.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yisi day of the sixth month in the third year; after twenty-three years, in the fourth year of Yuanguang, he was guilty of a crime and executed in the marketplace.

cells.content: 蓋靖侯王信
cells.literal: Gai Jing Marquis Wang Xin
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Gai: Wang Xin

cells.content: 以皇后兄侯。
cells.literal: Because empress elder brother marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as elder brother of the empress.

cells.content: 中五年五月甲戌封，二十五年薨。
cells.literal: Middle fifth year fifth month jiaxu day enfeoffed, twenty-five years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the jiaxu day of the fifth month in the middle fifth year; died after twenty-five years.

cells.content: 元光三年，頃侯充嗣。
cells.literal: Yuanguang third year, Qing Marquis Chong succeeded.
cells.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanguang, Qing Marquis Chong succeeded him.

cells.content: 侯受嗣，元鼎五年坐酎金免。
cells.literal: Marquis Shou succeeded, Yuanding fifth year sat tribute wine deficiency dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Shou succeeded him; in the fifth year of Yuanding he was convicted of tribute wine deficiency and dismissed.

cells.content: 武安侯田蚡
cells.literal: Wu'an Marquis Tian Fen
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Wu'an: Tian Fen

cells.content: 以皇太后同母弟侯。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager same-mother younger brother marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as younger brother of the empress dowager by the same mother.

cells.content: 孝景後三年三月封，十年薨。
cells.literal: Emperor Jing after third year third month enfeoffed, ten years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed in the third month of the third year after Emperor Jing; died after ten years.

cells.content: 元光四年，侯恬嗣，五年，元朔三年，坐衣襜褕入宮，不敬，免。
cells.literal: Yuanguang fourth year, Marquis Tian succeeded, five years, Yuanshuo third year, sat wearing short jacket entering palace, disrespect, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanguang, Marquis Tian succeeded him. After five years, in the third year of Yuanshuo, he was convicted of wearing a short jacket into the palace, disrespect, and dismissed.

cells.content: 周陽懿侯田勝
cells.literal: Zhouyang Yi Marquis Tian Sheng
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Yi of Zhouyang: Tian Sheng

cells.content: 以皇太后同母弟侯。
cells.literal: Because empress dowager same-mother younger brother marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as younger brother of the empress dowager by the same mother.

cells.content: 三月封，十二年薨。
cells.literal: Third month enfeoffed, twelve years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed in the third month; died after twelve years.

cells.content: 元光六年，侯祖嗣，八年，元狩三年，坐當歸軹侯宅不與，免。
cells.literal: Yuanguang sixth year, Marquis Zu succeeded, eight years, Yuanshou third year, sat ought return Zhi Marquis residence not give, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanguang, Marquis Zu succeeded him. After eight years, in the third year of Yuanshou, he was convicted of failing to return the residence of the Marquis of Zhi and was dismissed.

cells.content: 長平烈侯衛青
cells.literal: Changping Lie Marquis Wei Qing
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Lie of Changping: Wei Qing

cells.content: 以將軍擊匈奴取朔方侯，後破右賢王，益封，又封三子。皇后弟。
cells.literal: As general attacked Xiongnu took Shuofang marquis, later defeated Right Worthy King, increased enfeoffment, again enfeoffed three sons. Empress younger brother.
cells.idiomatic: As a general he attacked the Xiongnu and was made marquis for taking Shuofang; later he defeated the Right Worthy King, received an increased fief, and three sons were also enfeoffed. Younger brother of the empress.

cells.content: 元朔二年二月丙辰封，二十三年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanshuo second year second month bingchen day enfeoffed, twenty-three years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingchen day of the second month in the second year of Yuanshuo; died after twenty-three years.

cells.content: 宜春侯伉，五年四月丁未以青功封，元鼎元年坐撟制不害免，太初元年嗣侯，五年闌入宮，完為城旦。
cells.literal: Yichun Marquis Kang, fifth year fourth month dingwei because Qing merit enfeoffed, Yuanding first year sat forging orders not harm dismissed, Taichu first year succeeded marquis, fifth year intruded entering palace, reduced to convict labor.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yichun: Kang. Enfeoffed on the dingwei day of the fourth month in the fifth year for Qing's merit; in the first year of Yuanding convicted of forging imperial orders without harm and dismissed; in the first year of Taichu he succeeded as marquis; in the fifth year he intruded into the palace and was reduced to convict labor.

cells.content: 平津獻侯公孫弘
cells.literal: Pingjin Xian Marquis Gongsun Hong
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Xian of Pingjin: Gongsun Hong

cells.content: 以丞相詔所褒侯，三百七十三戶。
cells.literal: Because chancellor edict praised marquis, three hundred seventy-three households.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as chancellor praised in an edict, with 373 households.

cells.content: 元朔三年十一月乙丑封，六年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanshuo third year eleventh month yichou day enfeoffed, six years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yichou day of the eleventh month in the third year of Yuanshuo; died after six years.

cells.content: 元狩三年，侯度嗣，十三年，元封四年，坐為山陽太守詔徵鉅野令史成不遣，完為城旦。
cells.literal: Yuanshou third year, Marquis Du succeeded, thirteen years, Yuanfeng fourth year, sat as Shanyang governor edict summoned Juye clerk Cheng not sent, reduced to convict labor.
cells.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanshou, Marquis Du succeeded him. After thirteen years, in the fourth year of Yuanfeng, as governor of Shanyang he was convicted of failing to send the clerk Cheng of Juye when summoned by edict and was reduced to convict labor.

cells.content: 高城
cells.literal: Gao Cheng
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Gao Cheng

cells.content: 冠軍景桓侯霍去病
cells.literal: Guanjun Jinghuan Marquis Huo Qubing
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jinghuan of Guanjun: Huo Qubing

cells.content: 以校尉擊匈奴侯，後以將軍破祈連迎昆邪王，益封。皇后姊子。
cells.literal: As commandant attacked Xiongnu marquis, later as general broke Qilian welcomed Kunye King, increased enfeoffment. Empress elder sister's son.
cells.idiomatic: As commandant he attacked the Xiongnu and was made marquis; later as general he broke through at Qilian and welcomed King Kunye, receiving an increased fief. Son of the empress's elder sister.

cells.content: 六年四月壬申封，七年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth year fourth month renshen day enfeoffed, seven years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renshen day of the fourth month in the sixth year; died after seven years.

cells.content: 南陽元鼎元年，哀侯嬗嗣，七年薨，亡後。
cells.literal: Nanyang Yuanding first year, Ai Marquis Shan succeeded, seven years died, no heir.
cells.idiomatic: At Nanyang, in the first year of Yuanding, Ai Marquis Shan succeeded him; died after seven years with no heir.

cells.content: 樂平侯山，地節二年四月癸巳以從祖祖父大將軍光功封，三千戶，四年，坐謀反，誅。
cells.literal: Leping Marquis Shan, Dijie second year fourth month guisi because collateral great-grandfather Grand General Guang merit enfeoffed, three thousand households, four years, sat plotting rebellion, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Leping: Shan. Enfeoffed on the guisi day of the fourth month in the second year of Dijie for the merit of his collateral great-grandfather the Grand General Guang, with 3,000 households; after four years he was convicted of plotting rebellion and executed.

cells.content: 東郡
cells.literal: Dong commandery
cells.idiomatic: Dong commandery

cells.content: 周子南君姬嘉
cells.literal: Zhouzinan Lord Ji Jia
cells.idiomatic: Lord of Zhouzinan: Ji Jia

cells.content: 以周後詔所褒侯，三千戶。
cells.literal: Because Zhou descendant edict praised marquis, three thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as a descendant of Zhou praised in an edict, with 3,000 households.

cells.content: 元鼎四年十一月丁卯封，六年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanding fourth year eleventh month dingmao day enfeoffed, six years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingmao day of the eleventh month in the fourth year of Yuanding; died after six years.

cells.content: 元封四年，君置嗣，二十四年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanfeng fourth year, Lord Zhi succeeded, twenty-four years died.
cells.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanfeng, Lord Zhi succeeded him and died after twenty-four years.

cells.content: 始元四年，君當嗣，十六年，地節三年，坐使奴殺家丞，棄市。
cells.literal: Shiyuan fourth year, Lord Dang succeeded, sixteen years, Dijie third year, sat making slave kill household steward, executed in marketplace.
cells.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shiyuan, Lord Dang succeeded him. After sixteen years, in the third year of Dijie, he was convicted of making a slave kill his household steward and was executed in the marketplace.

cells.content: 長社
cells.literal: Changshe
cells.idiomatic: Changshe

cells.content: 樂通侯欒大
cells.literal: Letong Marquis Luan Da
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Letong: Luan Da

cells.content: 以方術詔所褒侯，三千戶。
cells.literal: Because occult arts edict praised marquis, three thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis for occult arts praised in an edict, with 3,000 households.

cells.content: 四年四月乙巳封，五年，坐罔上，要斬。
cells.literal: Fourth year fourth month yisi day enfeoffed, fifth year, sat deceiving superiors, waist execution.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yisi day of the fourth month in the fourth year; in the fifth year he was convicted of deceiving his superiors and executed by waist bisection.

cells.content: 高平
cells.literal: Gaoping
cells.idiomatic: Gaoping

cells.content: 牧丘恬侯石慶
cells.literal: Muqiu Tian Marquis Shi Qing
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Tian of Muqiu: Shi Qing

cells.content: 以丞相及父萬石積行侯。
cells.literal: Because chancellor and father Lord of Ten Thousand Shi accumulated conduct marquis.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as chancellor and for his father Lord of Ten Thousand Shi's accumulated conduct.

cells.content: 五年九月丁丑封，十年薨。
cells.literal: Fifth year ninth month dingchou day enfeoffed, ten years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingchou day of the ninth month in the fifth year; died after ten years.

cells.content: 太初三年，侯德嗣，二年，天漢元年，坐為太常失法罔上，祠不如令，完為城旦。
cells.literal: Taichu third year, Marquis De succeeded, two years, Tianhan first year, sat as Grand Master of Ceremonies lost law deceived superiors, sacrifices not according to regulations, reduced to convict labor.
cells.idiomatic: In the third year of Taichu, Marquis De succeeded him. After two years, in the first year of Tianhan, as Grand Master of Ceremonies he was convicted of violating the law, deceiving his superiors, and performing sacrifices not according to regulations, and was reduced to convict labor.

cells.content: 平原
cells.literal: Pingyuan
cells.idiomatic: Pingyuan

cells.content: 富民定侯車千秋
cells.literal: Fumin Ding Marquis Che Qianqiu
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ding of Fumin: Che Qianqiu

cells.content: 以丞相侯，八百戶，以遺詔益封，凡千六百戶。
cells.literal: Because chancellor marquis, eight hundred households, because testamentary edict increased enfeoffment, altogether one thousand six hundred households.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as chancellor with 800 households; enfeoffment was increased by testamentary edict to 1,600 households in all.

cells.content: 征和四年六月丁巳封，十二年薨。
cells.literal: Zhenghe fourth year sixth month dingsi day enfeoffed, twelve years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingsi day of the sixth month in the fourth year of Zhenghe; died after twelve years.

cells.content: 元鳳四年，侯順嗣，六年，本始三年，坐為虎牙將軍擊匈奴詐增虜獲，自殺。
cells.literal: Yuanfeng fourth year, Marquis Shun succeeded, six years, Benshi third year, sat as Tiger Tooth general attacking Xiongnu falsely increased captives taken, suicide.
cells.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanfeng, Marquis Shun succeeded him. After six years, in the third year of Benshi, as Tiger Tooth general attacking the Xiongnu he falsely inflated captives taken and committed suicide.

cells.content: 蘄
cells.literal: Qi
cells.idiomatic: Qi

sentences.zh: 右孝武九人。

translations.literal: Above: nine persons under Emperor Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists nine persons enfeoffed under Emperor Wu.

sentences.zh: 三人隨父，凡十二人。

translations.literal: Three persons listed with their fathers. In total, twelve persons.
translations.idiomatic: Three are listed with their fathers, for a total of twelve persons.

cells.content: 博陸宣成侯霍光
cells.literal: Bolu Xuancheng Marquis Huo Guang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Xuancheng of Bolu: Huo Guang

cells.content: 以奉車都尉捕反者莽何羅侯，二千三百五十戶，後以大將軍益封，萬七千二百戶。
cells.literal: As director of conveyances captured rebel Mang Heluo marquis, two thousand three hundred fifty households, later as grand general increased enfeoffment, ten thousand seven thousand two hundred households.
cells.idiomatic: As director of conveyances he captured the rebel Mang Heluo and was made marquis with 2,350 households; later as grand general his fief was increased to 17,200 households.

cells.content: 始元二年正月壬寅封，十七年薨。
cells.literal: Shiyuan second year first month renyin day enfeoffed, seventeen years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renyin day of the first month in the second year of Shiyuan; died after seventeen years.

cells.content: 地節二年四月癸卯，侯禹嗣，四年，謀反，要斬。
cells.literal: Dijie second year fourth month guimao, Marquis Yu succeeded, four years, plotted rebellion, waist execution.
cells.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fourth month in the second year of Dijie, Marquis Yu succeeded him; after four years he plotted rebellion and was executed by waist bisection.

cells.content: 元始二年四月乙酉，侯陽以光從父昆弟之曾孫龍勒士伍紹封，三千戶，王莽篡位，絕。
cells.literal: Yuanshi second year fourth month yiyou, Marquis Yang because Guang collateral father's uterine younger brother's great-grandson Longle common soldier Shao enfeoffed, three thousand households, Wang Mang usurped throne, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fourth month in the second year of Yuanshi, Marquis Yang was enfeoffed as great-grandson of Guang's collateral father's uterine younger brother, the common soldier Shao of Longle, with 3,000 households; the line became extinct when Wang Mang usurped the throne.

cells.content: 北海河間東郡
cells.literal: Beihai Hejian Dong commanderies
cells.idiomatic: Beihai, Hejian, and Dong commanderies

cells.content: 安陽侯上官桀
cells.literal: Anyang Marquis Shangguan Jie
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Anyang: Shangguan Jie

cells.content: 以騎都尉捕反者莽何羅侯，二千三百戶。女孫為皇后。
cells.literal: As commandant of cavalry captured rebel Mang Heluo marquis, two thousand three hundred households. Granddaughter was empress.
cells.idiomatic: As commandant of cavalry he captured the rebel Mang Heluo and was made marquis with 2,300 households. His granddaughter became empress.

cells.content: 正月壬寅封，五年，元鳳元年，反，誅。
cells.literal: First month renyin day enfeoffed, five years, Yuanfeng first year, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renyin day of the first month; after five years, in the first year of Yuanfeng, he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 桑樂侯安始元五年六月辛丑以皇后父車騎將軍封，千五百戶，二年，反，誅。
cells.literal: Sangle Marquis An Shiyuan fifth year sixth month xinchou because empress's father chariot and cavalry general enfeoffed, one thousand five hundred households, two years, rebelled, executed.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Sangle: An. Enfeoffed on the xinchou day of the sixth month in the fifth year of Shiyuan as empress's father and chariot and cavalry general, with 1,500 households; after two years he rebelled and was executed.

cells.content: 蕩陰千乘
cells.literal: Dangyin Qiansheng
cells.idiomatic: Dangyin and Qiansheng

cells.content: 宜春敬侯王訢
cells.literal: Yichun Jing Marquis Wang Xin
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Yichun: Wang Xin

cells.content: 以丞相侯，子譚與大將軍光定策，益封，坐法削戶五百，定六百八戶。
cells.literal: Because chancellor marquis, son Tan with Grand General Guang settled policy, increased enfeoffment, sat law reduced households five hundred, fixed six hundred eight households.
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis as chancellor; his son Tan, with Grand General Guang, settled the succession and received an increased fief; convicted by law, 500 households were cut, fixing the fief at 608 households.

cells.content: 元鳳四年二月乙丑封，二年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanfeng fourth year second month yichou day enfeoffed, two years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yichou day of the second month in the fourth year of Yuanfeng; died after two years.

cells.content: 元鳳六年，康侯譚嗣，四十五年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanfeng sixth year, Kang Marquis Tan succeeded, forty-five years died.
cells.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, Kang Marquis Tan succeeded him and died after forty-five years.

cells.content: 建始三年，孝侯咸嗣，十八年薨。
cells.literal: Jianshi third year, Marquis Xiao Xian succeeded, eighteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianshi 3, Marquis Xiao — Xian — inherited the title. He died after eighteen years.

cells.content: 元延元年，釐侯章嗣，八年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanyan first year, Marquis Li Zhang succeeded, eight years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanyan 1, Marquis Li — Zhang — inherited the title. He died after eight years.

cells.content: 汝南建平三年，侯強嗣，二十六年，更始元年，為兵所殺。
cells.literal: Runan Jianping third year, Marquis Qiang succeeded, twenty-six years, Gengshi first year, by soldiers killed.
cells.idiomatic: At Runan, in Jianping 3, Marquis Qiang inherited the title. After twenty-six years, in Gengshi 1, he was killed by soldiers.

cells.content: 安平敬侯楊敞
cells.literal: Anping Jing Marquis Yang Chang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Anping: Yang Chang

cells.content: 以丞相侯，七百戶，與大司馬大將軍光定策，益封子忠，凡五千五百四十七戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor marquis, seven hundred households, with Grand Marshal Grand General Guang established succession, additional enfeoffment son Zhong, total five thousand five hundred forty-seven households.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed as marquis while Chancellor, with 700 households. With Grand Marshal and Grand General Huo Guang he established the succession and received additional enfeoffment for his son Zhong, totaling 5,547 households.

cells.content: 六年二月乙丑封，一年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth year second month yichou enfeoffed, one year died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yichou day of the second month in the sixth year. He died after one year.

cells.content: 元平元年，頃侯忠嗣，十一年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanping first year, Marquis Qing Zhong succeeded, eleven years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanping 1, Marquis Qing — Zhong — inherited the title. He died after eleven years.

cells.content: 元康三年，侯譚嗣，九年，五鳳四年，坐為典屬國季父惲有罪，譚言誹，免。
cells.literal: Yuankang third year, Marquis Tan succeeded, nine years, Wufeng fourth year, convicted as Director of Dependent States uncle Yun had crime, Tan spoke slander, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuankang 3, Marquis Tan inherited the title. After nine years, in Wufeng 4, he was dismissed after his uncle Yun, Director of Dependent States, was found guilty and Tan spoke slanderously about the case.

cells.content: 汝南
cells.literal: Ru Nan
cells.idiomatic: Ru Nan

cells.content: 富平敬侯張安世
cells.literal: Fuping Jing Marquis Zhang Anshi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Fuping: Zhang Anshi

cells.content: 以右將軍光祿勳輔政勤勞侯，以車騎將軍與大將軍光定策，益封，凡萬三千六百四十戶。
cells.literal: As Right General Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness assisting government diligent service marquis, as General of Chariots and Cavalry with Grand General Guang established succession, additional enfeoffment, total ten thousand three thousand six hundred forty households.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed for diligent service as Right General and Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness while assisting the government. As General of Chariots and Cavalry, with Grand General Huo Guang he established the succession and received additional enfeoffment, totaling 13,640 households.

cells.content: 十一月乙丑封，十三年薨。
cells.literal: November yichou enfeoffed, thirteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yichou day in the eleventh month. He died after thirteen years.

cells.content: 陽都元康四年，愛侯延壽嗣，十一年薨。元康三年三月乙未，侯彭祖以世父故掖庭令賀有舊恩封，千六百戶，四年，神爵三年，為小妻所殺。
cells.literal: Yangdu Yuankang fourth year, Marquis Ai Yanshou succeeded, eleven years died. Yuankang third year third month yiwei, Marquis Pengzu because father's elder brother former Palace Procurator He had old grace enfeoffed, one thousand six hundred households, four years, Shenjue third year, by minor wife killed.
cells.idiomatic: In Yangdu, in Yuankang 4, Marquis Ai — Yanshou — inherited the title and died after eleven years. In Yuankang 3, on the yiwei day of the third month, Marquis Pengzu was enfeoffed with 1,600 households for the old favor of He, the former Palace Procurator and his father's elder brother. After four years, in Shenjue 3, he was killed by his concubine.

cells.content: 甘露三年，繆侯敞嗣，四年薨。
cells.literal: Ganlu third year, Marquis Mou Chang succeeded, four years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Ganlu 3, Marquis Mou — Chang — inherited the title. He died after four years.

cells.content: 初元二年，共侯臨嗣，十五年薨。
cells.literal: Chuyuan second year, Marquis Gong Lin succeeded, fifteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Gong — Lin — inherited the title. He died after fifteen years.

cells.content: 平原思侯放嗣，三十六年薨。
cells.literal: Pingyuan Si Marquis Fang succeeded, thirty-six years died.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Si of Pingyuan — Fang — inherited the title. He died after thirty-six years.

cells.content: 陽平節侯蔡義
cells.literal: Yangping Jie Marquis Cai Yi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie of Yangping: Cai Yi

cells.content: 以丞相侯，前為御史大夫與大將軍光定策，益封，凡七百戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor marquis, formerly as Censor-in-Chief with Grand General Guang established succession, additional enfeoffment, total seven hundred households.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed as marquis while Chancellor; formerly, as Censor-in-Chief, with Grand General Huo Guang he established the succession and received additional enfeoffment, for a total of 700 households.

cells.content: 元平元年九月戊戌封，三年，本始四年薨，亡後。
cells.literal: Yuanping first year ninth month xushu enfeoffed, three years, Benshi fourth year died, no heir.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xushu day of the ninth month in Yuanping 1. After three years, in Benshi 4 he died with no heir.

sentences.zh: 右孝昭六人。

translations.literal: Above: six persons under Emperor Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists six persons enfeoffed under Emperor Zhao.

sentences.zh: 一人桑樂侯隨父，凡七人。

translations.literal: One person, the Marquis of Sangle, listed with his father. In total, seven persons.
translations.idiomatic: One — the Marquis of Sangle — is listed with his father, for a total of seven persons.

cells.content: 營平壯侯趙充國
cells.literal: Yingping Zhuang Marquis Zhao Chongguo
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Zhuang of Yingping: Zhao Chongguo

cells.content: 以後將軍與大將軍光定策功侯，千二百七十九戶。
cells.literal: As Rear General with Grand General Guang established succession merit marquis, one thousand two hundred seventy-nine households.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed for merit as Rear General for establishing the succession with Grand General Huo Guang, with 1,279 households.

cells.content: 本始元年八月辛未封，二十二年薨。
cells.literal: Benshi first year eighth month xinwei enfeoffed, twenty-two years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinwei day of the eighth month in Benshi 1. He died after twenty-two years.

cells.content: 甘露三年，質侯弘嗣，二十□年薨。
cells.literal: Ganlu third year, Marquis Zhi Hong succeeded, twenty □ years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Ganlu 3, Marquis Zhi — Hong — inherited the title. He died after twenty [text damaged] years.

cells.content: 建始四年，考侯欽嗣，七年薨。
cells.literal: Jianshi fourth year, Marquis Kao Qin succeeded, seven years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianshi 4, Marquis Kao — Qin — inherited the title. He died after seven years.

cells.content: 陽朔三年，侯岑嗣，十二年，元延三年，坐父欽詐以長安女子王君俠子為嗣，免。戶二千九百四十四。
cells.literal: Yangshuo third year, Marquis Cen succeeded, twelve years, Yuanyan third year, convicted father Qin deceived using Chang'an woman Wang Junxia's son as heir, dismissed. Households two thousand nine hundred forty-four.
