cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed for old grace as Changle Commandant-Guardian, full younger brother of the crown prince's maternal grandfather, with 1,500 households.

cells.content: 三月乙未封，四年薨。
cells.literal: Third month yiwei enfeoffed, four years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yiwei day in the third month. He died after four years.

cells.content: 神爵三年，康侯敞嗣，八年薨。
cells.literal: Shenjue third year, Marquis Kang Chang succeeded, eight years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Shenjue 3, Marquis Kang — Chang — inherited the title. He died after eight years.

cells.content: 甘露三年，戾侯黨嗣，二十六年薨。
cells.literal: Ganlu third year, Marquis Li Dang succeeded, twenty-six years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Ganlu 3, Marquis Li — Dang — inherited the title. He died after twenty-six years.

cells.content: 河平四年，釐侯並嗣，薨，亡後。
cells.literal: Heping fourth year, Marquis Li Bing succeeded, died, no heir.
cells.idiomatic: In Heping 4, Marquis Li — Bing — inherited the title, died, with no heir.

cells.content: 樂成敬侯許延壽
cells.literal: Le Cheng Jing Marquis Xu Yanshou
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Le Cheng: Xu Yanshou

cells.content: 以皇太子外祖父同產弟侍中關內侯有舊恩侯，千五百戶。
cells.literal: As crown prince's maternal grandfather's full younger brother, Palace Attendant, Marquis within the Passes with old favor, made marquis, 1,500 households.
cells.idiomatic: As the crown prince's maternal grandfather's uterine younger brother, a Palace Attendant and Marquis within the Passes who enjoyed old imperial favor, he was made marquis with a fief of 1,500 households.

cells.content: 三月乙未封，十年薨。
cells.literal: Third month yiwei day enfeoffed, ten years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yiwei day of the third month. He died ten years later.

cells.content: 甘露元年，思侯湯嗣，六年薨。
cells.literal: Ganlu first year, Si Marquis Tang succeeded, six years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Ganlu 1, Marquis Si — Tang — inherited the title. He died six years later.

cells.content: 初元二年，哀侯常嗣，九年薨。
cells.literal: Chuyuan second year, Ai Marquis Chang succeeded, nine years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Ai — Chang — inherited the title. He died nine years later.

cells.content: 平氏
cells.literal: Ping Shi
cells.idiomatic: Ping Shi

cells.content: 博陽定侯丙吉
cells.literal: Bo Yang Ding Marquis Bing Ji
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ding of Boyang: Bing Ji

cells.content: 以御史大夫關內侯有舊恩功德茂侯，千三百三十戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Censor, Marquis within the Passes with old favor and abundant merit and virtue, made marquis, 1,330 households.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Censor and Marquis within the Passes who enjoyed old favor and whose merit and virtue were abundant, he was made marquis with a fief of 1,330 households.

cells.content: 元康三年二月乙未封，八年薨。
cells.literal: Yuankang third year second month yiwei day enfeoffed, eight years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yiwei day of the second month in Yuankang 3. He died eight years later.

cells.content: 五鳳三年，侯顯嗣，二年，甘露元年坐酎宗廟騎至司馬門，不敬，奪爵一級為關內侯。
cells.literal: Wufeng third year, Marquis Xian succeeded, two years, Ganlu first year convicted of tribute-wine ancestral temple riding to Sima Gate, disrespect, stripped one rank of nobility made Marquis within the Passes.
cells.idiomatic: In Wufeng 3, Marquis Xian inherited the title. After two years, in Ganlu 1, he was convicted of riding to the Sima Gate during the tribute-wine sacrifice at the ancestral temple — an act of disrespect — and was stripped of one rank of nobility, becoming Marquis within the Passes.

cells.content: 鴻嘉元年六月己巳，康侯昌以吉孫紹封。
cells.literal: Hongjia first year sixth month jisi day, Kang Marquis Chang as Ji grandson continued enfeoffment.
cells.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the sixth month in Hongjia 1, Kang Marquis Chang was enfeoffed to continue the line as Bing Ji's grandson.

cells.content: 元始二年，釐侯並嗣。
cells.literal: Yuanshi second year, Li Marquis Bing succeeded.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 2, Marquis Li — Bing — inherited the title.

cells.content: 南頓侯勝客嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Nandun Marquis Shengke succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Shengke of Nandun inherited the title. When Wang Mang was defeated, the line became extinct.

cells.content: 建成定侯黃霸
cells.literal: Jian Cheng Ding Marquis Huang Ba
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ding of Jiancheng: Huang Ba

cells.content: 以丞相侯，六百戶，侯賞以定陶太后不宜立號，益封，二千二百戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor made marquis, 600 households, Marquis Shang because Dingtao Empress Dowager inappropriate establishment of title, additional enfeoffment, 2,200 households.
cells.idiomatic: As Chancellor he was made marquis with 600 households. Marquis Shang, for advising that Empress Dowager Dingtao should not be given an improper title, received an additional grant, bringing the fief to 2,200 households.

cells.content: 五鳳三年二月壬申封，四年薨。
cells.literal: Wufeng third year second month renshen day enfeoffed, four years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renshen day of the second month in Wufeng 3. He died four years later.

cells.content: 甘露三年，思侯賞嗣，三十年薨。
cells.literal: Ganlu third year, Si Marquis Shang succeeded, thirty years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Ganlu 3, Marquis Si — Shang — inherited the title. He died thirty years later.

cells.content: 陽朔三年，忠侯輔嗣，二十七年薨。
cells.literal: Yangshuo third year, Zhong Marquis Fu succeeded, twenty-seven years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Yangshuo 3, Marquis Zhong — Fu — inherited the title. He died twenty-seven years later.

cells.content: 居攝二年，侯輔嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Jushe second year, Marquis Fu succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In Jushe 2, Marquis Fu inherited the title. When Wang Mang was defeated, the line became extinct.

cells.content: 沛
cells.literal: Pei
cells.idiomatic: Pei

cells.content: 西平安侯于定國
cells.literal: Xi An An Marquis Yu Dingguo
cells.idiomatic: Marquis An of Xi'an: Yu Dingguo

cells.content: 以丞相侯，六百六十戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor made marquis, 660 households.
cells.idiomatic: As Chancellor he was made marquis with a fief of 660 households.

cells.content: 甘露三年五月甲子封，十一年薨。
cells.literal: Ganlu third year fifth month jiazi day enfeoffed, eleven years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the jiazi day of the fifth month in Ganlu 3. He died eleven years later.

cells.content: 永光四年，頃侯永嗣，二十四年薨。
cells.literal: Yongguang fourth year, Qing Marquis Yong succeeded, twenty-four years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Yongguang 4, Marquis Qing — Yong — inherited the title. He died twenty-four years later.

cells.content: 鴻嘉元年，侯恬嗣，四十三年，更始元年絕。
cells.literal: Hongjia first year, Marquis Tian succeeded, forty-three years, Gengshi first year extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In Hongjia 1, Marquis Tian inherited the title. After forty-three years, the line became extinct in Gengshi 1.

cells.content: 臨淮
cells.literal: Lin Huai
cells.idiomatic: Lin Huai

sentences.zh: 右孝宣二十人。

translations.literal: Above: twenty persons under Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists twenty persons enfeoffed under Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 一人陽都侯隨父，凡二十一人。

translations.literal: One person, the Marquis of Yangdu, listed with his father. In total, twenty-one persons.
translations.idiomatic: One — the Marquis of Yangdu — is listed with his father, for a total of twenty-one persons.

cells.content: 陽平頃侯王禁
cells.literal: Yang Ping Qing Marquis Wang Jin
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Qing of Yangping: Wang Jin

cells.content: 以皇后父侯，二千六百戶，子鳳以大將軍益封五千四百戶，凡八千戶。
cells.literal: As empress's father made marquis, 2,600 households, son Feng as Grand General additional enfeoffment 5,400 households, altogether 8,000 households.
cells.idiomatic: As the empress's father he was made marquis with 2,600 households. His son Feng, as Grand General, received an additional grant of 5,400 households, for a total of 8,000.

cells.content: 初元元年三月癸卯封，六年薨。
cells.literal: Chuyuan first year third month guimao day enfeoffed, six years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the guimao day of the third month in Chuyuan 1. He died six years later.

cells.content: 永光二年，敬成侯鳳嗣，二十年薨。
cells.literal: Yongguang second year, Jing Cheng Marquis Feng succeeded, twenty years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Yongguang 2, Marquis Jingcheng — Feng — inherited the title. He died twenty years later.

cells.content: 陽朔三年，釐侯襄嗣，十九年薨。
cells.literal: Yangshuo third year, Li Marquis Xiang succeeded, nineteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Yangshuo 3, Marquis Li — Xiang — inherited the title. He died nineteen years later.

cells.content: 建平四年，康侯岑嗣，十三年薨。
cells.literal: Jianping fourth year, Kang Marquis Cen succeeded, thirteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianping 4, Marquis Kang — Cen — inherited the title. He died thirteen years later.

cells.content: 東郡建國三年，侯莫嗣，十二年，更始元年，為兵所殺。
cells.literal: Dong commandery, Jianguo third year, Marquis Mo succeeded, twelve years, Gengshi first year, killed by soldiers.
cells.idiomatic: In Dong commandery, in Jianguo 3, Marquis Mo inherited the title. After twelve years, in Gengshi 1, he was killed by soldiers.

cells.content: 安成共侯崇
cells.literal: An Cheng Gong Marquis Chong
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Gong of Ancheng: Chong

cells.content: 建始元年二月壬子，以皇太后母弟散騎光祿大夫關內侯侯，萬戶，二年薨。
cells.literal: Jianshi first year second month renzi day, as Empress Dowager's maternal younger brother Rapid Cavalry Regular Palace Attendant Marquis within the Passes made marquis, ten thousand households, two years died.
cells.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the second month in Jianshi 1, as the Empress Dowager's maternal younger brother — a Rapid Cavalry Regular Palace Attendant and Marquis within the Passes — he was made marquis with a fief of ten thousand households. He died two years later.

cells.content: 建始三年，靖侯奉世嗣，三十九年薨。
cells.literal: Jianshi third year, Jing Marquis Fengshi succeeded, thirty-nine years died.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianshi 3, Marquis Jing — Fengshi — inherited the title. He died thirty-nine years later.

cells.content: 建國二年，侯持弓嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Jianguo second year, Marquis Chigong succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianguo 2, Marquis Chigong inherited the title. When Wang Mang was defeated, the line became extinct.

cells.content: 汝南
cells.literal: Ru Nan
cells.idiomatic: Runan

cells.content: 平阿安侯譚
cells.literal: Ping A An Marquis Tan
cells.idiomatic: Marquis An of Ping'a: Tan

cells.content: 河平二年六月乙亥，以皇太后弟關內侯侯，二千一百戶，十一年薨。
cells.literal: Heping second year sixth month yihai day, as Empress Dowager's younger brother Marquis within the Passes made marquis, 2,100 households, eleven years died.
cells.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the sixth month in Heping 2, as the Empress Dowager's younger brother and Marquis within the Passes he was made marquis with 2,100 households. He died eleven years later.

cells.content: 永始元年，剌侯仁嗣，十九年，為王莽所殺。
cells.literal: Yongshi first year, Ci Marquis Ren succeeded, nineteen years, by Wang Mang killed.
cells.idiomatic: In Yongshi 1, Marquis Ci — Ren — inherited the title. After nineteen years he was killed by Wang Mang.

cells.content: 元始四年，侯述嗣，建武二年薨，絕。
cells.literal: Yuanshi fourth year, Marquis Shu succeeded, Jianwu second year died, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 4, Marquis Shu inherited the title. He died in Jianwu 2, and the line became extinct.

cells.content: 沛
cells.literal: Pei
cells.idiomatic: Pei

cells.content: 成都景成侯商
cells.literal: Cheng Du Jing Cheng Marquis Shang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jingcheng of Chengdu: Shang

cells.content: 六月乙亥，以皇太后弟關內侯侯，二千戶，以大司馬益封二千戶，十六年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth month yihai day, as Empress Dowager's younger brother Marquis within the Passes made marquis, 2,000 households, as Grand Marshal additional enfeoffment 2,000 households, sixteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the sixth month, as the Empress Dowager's younger brother and Marquis within the Passes he was made marquis with 2,000 households. As Grand Marshal he received an additional grant of 2,000 households. He died sixteen years later.

cells.content: 元延四年，侯況嗣，四年，綏和二年，坐山陵未成置酒歌舞，免。
cells.literal: Yuanyan fourth year, Marquis Kuang succeeded, four years, Suihe second year convicted of imperial tomb not completed setting out wine song dance, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanyan 4, Marquis Kuang inherited the title. After four years, in Suihe 2, he was convicted of holding wine and dance while the imperial tomb was not yet completed, and was dismissed.

cells.content: 山陽
cells.literal: Shan Yang
cells.idiomatic: Shanyang

cells.content: 紅陽荒侯立
cells.literal: Hong Yang Huang Marquis Li
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Huang of Hongyang: Li

cells.content: 六月乙亥封，以皇太后弟關內侯侯，二千一百戶，三十年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth month yihai day enfeoffed, as Empress Dowager's younger brother Marquis within the Passes made marquis, 2,100 households, thirty years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yihai day of the sixth month. As the Empress Dowager's younger brother and Marquis within the Passes he was made marquis with 2,100 households. He died thirty years later.

cells.content: 元始四年，侯柱嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Yuanshi fourth year, Marquis Zhu succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 4, Marquis Zhu inherited the title. When Wang Mang was defeated, the line became extinct.

cells.content: 曾孫武桓侯泓，建武元年以父丹為將軍戰死，往與上有舊，侯。
cells.literal: Great-grandson Wu Huan Marquis Hong, Jianwu first year because father Dan as general died in battle, formerly with emperor had old ties, made marquis.
cells.idiomatic: His great-grandson, Marquis Wuhuan Hong, was made marquis in Jianwu 1 because his father Dan had died in battle as a general and had formerly enjoyed old ties with the emperor.

cells.content: 南陽
cells.literal: Nan Yang
cells.idiomatic: Nanyang

cells.content: 曲陽煬侯根
cells.literal: Qu Yang Yang Marquis Gen
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Yang of Quyang: Gen

cells.content: 六月乙亥，以皇太后弟關內侯侯，三千七百戶，再以大司馬益封七千七百戶，哀帝又益二千戶，凡萬二千四百戶，二十一年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth month yihai day, as Empress Dowager's younger brother Marquis within the Passes made marquis, 3,700 households, again as Grand Marshal additional enfeoffment 7,700 households, Emperor Ai again additional 2,000 households, altogether 12,400 households, twenty-one years died.
cells.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the sixth month, as the Empress Dowager's younger brother and Marquis within the Passes he was made marquis with 3,700 households. As Grand Marshal he received a further grant of 7,700 households; Emperor Ai added another 2,000, for a total of 12,400 households. He died twenty-one years later.

cells.content: 建平元年，侯涉嗣，王莽篡位，為直道公，為莽所殺。
cells.literal: Jianping first year, Marquis She succeeded, Wang Mang usurped throne, made Straight Road Duke, by Mang killed.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianping 1, Marquis She inherited the title. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he was made Duke of Straight Road and was killed by Mang.

cells.content: 九江
cells.literal: Jiu Jiang
cells.idiomatic: Jiujiang

cells.content: 高平戴侯逢時
cells.literal: Gao Ping Dai Marquis Fengshi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Dai of Gaoping: Fengshi

cells.content: 六月乙亥，以皇太后弟關內侯侯，三千戶，十八年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth month yihai day, as Empress Dowager's younger brother Marquis within the Passes made marquis, 3,000 households, eighteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the sixth month, as the Empress Dowager's younger brother and Marquis within the Passes he was made marquis with 3,000 households. He died eighteen years later.

cells.content: 元延四年，侯置嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Yuanyan fourth year, Marquis Zhi succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanyan 4, Marquis Zhi inherited the title. When Wang Mang was defeated, the line became extinct.

cells.content: 臨淮
cells.literal: Lin Huai
cells.idiomatic: Lin Huai

cells.content: 樂安侯匡衡
cells.literal: Le An Marquis Kuang Heng
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Le'an: Kuang Heng

cells.content: 以丞相侯，六百四十七戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor made marquis, 647 households.
cells.idiomatic: As Chancellor he was made marquis with a fief of 647 households.

cells.content: 建昭三年七月癸亥封，七年，建始四年，坐顓地盜土，免。
cells.literal: Jianzhao third year seventh month guihai day enfeoffed, seven years, Jianshi fourth year convicted of encroaching land stealing earth, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the guihai day of the seventh month in Jianzhao 3. After seven years, in Jianshi 4, he was convicted of encroaching on land and stealing earth from burial mounds, and was dismissed.

cells.content: 僮
cells.literal: Tong
cells.idiomatic: Tong

sentences.zh: 右孝元二人。

translations.literal: Above: two persons under Emperor Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists two persons enfeoffed under Emperor Yuan.

sentences.zh: 一人安平侯隨父，凡三人。

translations.literal: One person, the Marquis of Anping, listed with his father. In total, three persons.
translations.idiomatic: One — the Marquis of Anping — is listed with his father, for a total of three persons.

cells.content: 安昌節侯張禹
cells.literal: An Chang Jie Marquis Zhang Yu
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie of Anchang: Zhang Yu

cells.content: 以丞相侯，六百一十七戶，益戶四百。
cells.literal: As Chancellor made marquis, 617 households, additional households 400.
cells.idiomatic: As Chancellor he was made marquis with 617 households, with an additional grant of 400 households.

cells.content: 河平四年六月丙午封，二十一年薨。
cells.literal: Heping fourth year sixth month bingwu day enfeoffed, twenty-one years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingwu day of the sixth month in Heping 4. He died twenty-one years later.

cells.content: 建平二年，侯宏嗣，二十八年，更始元年，為兵所殺。
cells.literal: Jianping second year, Marquis Hong succeeded, twenty-eight years, Gengshi first year, killed by soldiers.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianping 2, Marquis Hong inherited the title. After twenty-eight years, in Gengshi 1, he was killed by soldiers.

cells.content: 汝南
cells.literal: Ru Nan
cells.idiomatic: Runan

cells.content: 高陽侯薛宣
cells.literal: Gao Yang Marquis Xue Xuan
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Gaoyang: Xue Xuan

cells.content: 以丞相侯，千九十戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor made marquis, 1,090 households.
cells.idiomatic: As Chancellor he was made marquis with a fief of 1,090 households.

cells.content: 鴻嘉元年四月庚辰封，五年，永始二年，坐西州盜賊群輩免，其年復封，十年，綏和二年，坐不忠孝，父子賊傷近臣，免。
cells.literal: Hongjia first year fourth month gengchen day enfeoffed, five years, Yongshi second year convicted of western provinces bandits groups dismissed, that year again enfeoffed, ten years, Suihe second year convicted of disloyalty unfiliality, father son injuring near ministers, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the gengchen day of the fourth month in Hongjia 1. After five years, in Yongshi 2, he was convicted in connection with bandit gangs in the western provinces and dismissed; that same year he was re-enfeoffed. After ten years, in Suihe 2, he was convicted of disloyalty and unfilial conduct — father and son having harmed a court favorite — and was dismissed.

cells.content: 東莞
cells.literal: Dong Guan
cells.idiomatic: Dongguan

cells.content: 安陽敬侯王音
cells.literal: An Yang Jing Marquis Wang Yin
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Anyang: Wang Yin

cells.content: 以皇太后從弟大司馬車騎將軍侯，千六百戶，子舜益封。
cells.literal: As Empress Dowager's younger cousin Grand Marshal Chariots and Cavalry General made marquis, 1,600 households, son Shun additional enfeoffment.
cells.idiomatic: As the Empress Dowager's younger cousin and Grand Marshal and General of Chariots and Cavalry he was made marquis with 1,600 households. His son Shun received an additional grant.

cells.content: 六月己巳封，五年薨。
cells.literal: Sixth month jisi day enfeoffed, five years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the jisi day of the sixth month. He died five years later.

cells.content: 永始二年，侯舜嗣，王莽篡位，為安新公。
cells.literal: Yongshi second year, Marquis Shun succeeded, Wang Mang usurped throne, made Anxin Duke.
cells.idiomatic: In Yongshi 2, Marquis Shun inherited the title. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he was made Duke of Anxin.

cells.content: 建國三年，公攝嗣，更號和新公，與莽俱死。
cells.literal: Jianguo third year, Duke She succeeded, changed title to Hexin Duke, with Mang together died.
cells.idiomatic: In Jianguo 3, Duke She inherited the title, took the new title Duke of Hexin, and died together with Mang.

cells.content: 成陽節侯趙臨
cells.literal: Cheng Yang Jie Marquis Zhao Lin
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie of Chengyang: Zhao Lin

cells.content: 以皇后父侯，二千戶。
cells.literal: As empress's father made marquis, 2,000 households.
cells.idiomatic: As the empress's father he was made marquis with a fief of 2,000 households.

cells.content: 永始元年四月乙亥封，五年薨。
cells.literal: Yongshi first year fourth month yihai day enfeoffed, five years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yihai day of the fourth month in Yongshi 1. He died five years later.

cells.content: 元延二年，侯訢嗣，建平元年，坐弟昭儀絕繼嗣，免，徙遼西。
cells.literal: Yuanyan second year, Marquis Xin succeeded, Jianping first year convicted of younger brother Lady of Brilliant Deportment severing succession, dismissed, relocated to Liaoxi.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanyan 2, Marquis Xin inherited the title. In Jianping 1, he was convicted because his younger brother the Lady of Brilliant Deportment had cut off the succession, was dismissed, and was relocated to Liaoxi.

cells.content: 新息
cells.literal: Xin Xi
cells.idiomatic: Xinxi

cells.content: 新成侯欽
cells.literal: Xin Cheng Marquis Qin
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Xincheng: Qin

cells.content: 綏和二年五月壬辰以皇太后弟封，一年，建平元年，坐弟昭儀絕繼嗣，免，徙遼西。
cells.literal: Suihe second year fifth month renchen day as Empress Dowager's younger brother enfeoffed, one year, Jianping first year convicted of younger brother Lady of Brilliant Deportment severing succession, dismissed, relocated to Liaoxi.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renchen day of the fifth month in Suihe 2 as the Empress Dowager's younger brother. After one year, in Jianping 1, he was convicted because his younger brother the Lady of Brilliant Deportment had cut off the succession, was dismissed, and was relocated to Liaoxi.

cells.content: 穰
cells.literal: Rang
cells.idiomatic: Rang

cells.content: 高陵共侯翟方進
cells.literal: Gao Ling Gong Marquis Zhai Fangjin
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Gong of Gaoling: Zhai Fangjin

cells.content: 以丞相侯，千戶，哀帝即位，益子宣五百戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor made marquis, 1,000 households, Emperor Ai ascended throne, additional son Xuan 500 households.
cells.idiomatic: As Chancellor he was made marquis with 1,000 households. When Emperor Ai ascended the throne, his son Xuan received an additional grant of 500 households.

cells.content: 永始二年十一月壬子封，八千戶，八年薨。
cells.literal: Yongshi second year eleventh month renzi day enfeoffed, 8,000 households, eight years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renzi day of the eleventh month in Yongshi 2 with a fief of 8,000 households. He died eight years later.

cells.content: 綏和二年，侯宣嗣，十二年，居攝元年，弟東郡太守義舉兵欲討莽，莽滅其宗。
cells.literal: Suihe second year, Marquis Xuan succeeded, twelve years, Jushe first year, younger brother Dong commandery Administrator Yi raised troops wishing to attack Mang, Mang extinguished his clan.
cells.idiomatic: In Suihe 2, Marquis Xuan inherited the title. After twelve years, in Jushe 1, his younger brother Yi, Administrator of Dong commandery, raised troops intending to attack Mang; Mang exterminated the clan.

cells.content: 琅邪
cells.literal: Lang Ye
cells.idiomatic: Langye

cells.content: 定陵侯淳于長
cells.literal: Ding Ling Marquis Chunyu Chang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Dingling: Chunyu Chang

cells.content: 以侍中衛尉言昌陵不可成侯，千戶。皇太后姊子。
cells.literal: As Palace Attendant Defender saying Changling cannot be completed made marquis, 1,000 households. Empress Dowager's sister's son.
cells.idiomatic: As Palace Attendant and Defender, for stating that Changling could not be completed, he was made marquis with 1,000 households. He was the Empress Dowager's sister's son.

cells.content: 元延三年二月丙午封，二年，綏和元年，坐大逆，下獄死。
cells.literal: Yuanyan third year second month bingwu day enfeoffed, two years, Suihe first year convicted of great treason, imprisoned died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingwu day of the second month in Yuanyan 3. After two years, in Suihe 1, he was convicted of great treason, imprisoned, and died.

cells.content: 汝南
cells.literal: Ru Nan
cells.idiomatic: Runan

cells.content: 殷紹嘉侯孔何齊
cells.literal: Yin Shao Jia Marquis Kong Heqi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Shaojia of the Yin line: Kong Heqi

cells.content: 以殷後孔子世吉適子侯，千六百七十戶，後六月進爵為公，地方百里，建平二年益戶九百三十二。
cells.literal: As Yin descendant Confucius house direct-line heir made marquis, 1,670 households, later sixth month advanced rank to duke, territory one hundred li, Jianping second year additional households 932.
cells.idiomatic: As a descendant of the Yin and direct-line heir of Confucius's house, he was made marquis with 1,670 households. Six months later his rank was advanced to duke with a territory of one hundred li; in Jianping 2 he received an additional grant of 932 households.

cells.content: 綏和元年二月甲子封，八年，元始二年，更為宋公。
cells.literal: Suihe first year second month jiazi day enfeoffed, eight years, Yuanshi second year, changed to Song Duke.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the jiazi day of the second month in Suihe 1. After eight years, in Yuanshi 2, he was made Duke of Song.

cells.content: 沛
cells.literal: Pei
cells.idiomatic: Pei

cells.content: 宜鄉侯馮參
cells.literal: Yi Xiang Marquis Feng Can
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yixiang: Feng Can

cells.content: 以中山王舅侯，千戶。
cells.literal: As King of Zhongshan's maternal uncle made marquis, 1,000 households.
cells.idiomatic: As maternal uncle of the King of Zhongshan he was made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households.

cells.content: 綏和元年二月甲子封，建平元年，坐姊中山太后祝詛，自殺。
cells.literal: Suihe first year second month jiazi day enfeoffed, Jianping first year convicted of elder sister Zhongshan Empress Dowager curse, suicide.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the jiazi day of the second month in Suihe 1. In Jianping 1, he was convicted in connection with his elder sister the Empress Dowager of Zhongshan having placed a curse, and committed suicide.

cells.content: 氾鄉侯何武
cells.literal: Fan Xiang Marquis He Wu
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Fanxiang: He Wu

cells.content: 以大司空侯，千戶，哀帝即位益千戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Minister of Works made marquis, 1,000 households, Emperor Ai ascended throne additional 1,000 households.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Minister of Works he was made marquis with 1,000 households. When Emperor Ai ascended the throne, he received an additional grant of 1,000 households.

cells.content: 四月乙丑封，十年，元始三年，為莽所殺，賜諡曰剌。
cells.literal: Fourth month yichou day enfeoffed, ten years, Yuanshi third year, by Mang killed, bestowed posthumous title Ci.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yichou day of the fourth month. After ten years, in Yuanshi 3, he was killed by Mang and was given the posthumous title Ci.

cells.content: 元始四年，侯況嗣，建國四年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanshi fourth year, Marquis Kuang succeeded, Jianguo fourth year died.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 4, Marquis Kuang inherited the title. He died in Jianguo 4.

cells.content: 南陽
cells.literal: Nan Yang
cells.idiomatic: Nanyang

cells.content: 博山簡烈侯孔光
cells.literal: Bo Shan Jian Lie Marquis Kong Guang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jianlie of Boshan: Kong Guang

cells.content: 以丞相侯，千戶，元始元年益萬戶。
cells.literal: As Chancellor made marquis, 1,000 households, Yuanshi first year additional ten thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As Chancellor he was made marquis with 1,000 households. In Yuanshi 1 he received an additional grant of ten thousand households.

cells.content: 二年三月丙戌封，二年，建平二年，坐眾職廢，免，元壽元年五月乙卯復以丞相侯，六年薨。
cells.literal: Second year third month bingxu day enfeoffed, two years, Jianping second year convicted of numerous offices abolished, dismissed, Yuanshou first year fifth month yimao again as Chancellor made marquis, six years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingxu day of the third month in year 2. After two years, in Jianping 2, he was convicted in connection with the abolition of numerous offices and was dismissed. On the yimao day of the fifth month in Yuanshou 1 he was again made marquis as Chancellor. He died six years later.

cells.content: 元始五年，侯放嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Yuanshi fifth year, Marquis Fang succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 5, Marquis Fang inherited the title. When Wang Mang was defeated, the line became extinct.

cells.content: 順陽
cells.literal: Shun Yang
cells.idiomatic: Shunyang

sentences.zh: 右孝成十人。

translations.literal: Above: ten persons under Emperor Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists ten persons enfeoffed under Emperor Cheng.

sentences.zh: 安成、平阿、成都、紅陽、曲陽、高平、新都、武陽侯八人隨父，凡十八人。

translations.literal: The Marquises of Ancheng, Ping'a, Chengdu, Hongyang, Quyang, Gaoping, Xindu, and Wuyang — eight persons listed with their fathers. In total, eighteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Eight — the Marquises of Ancheng, Ping'a, Chengdu, Hongyang, Quyang, Gaoping, Xindu, and Wuyang — are listed with their fathers, for a total of eighteen persons.

cells.content: 陽安侯丁明
cells.literal: Yang An Marquis Ding Ming
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yang'an: Ding Ming

cells.content: 以帝舅侯，五千戶。
cells.literal: As emperor's maternal uncle made marquis, 5,000 households.
cells.idiomatic: As the emperor's maternal uncle he was made marquis with a fief of 5,000 households.

cells.content: 綏和二年四月壬寅封，七年，元始元年，為王莽所殺。
cells.literal: Suihe second year fourth month renyin day enfeoffed, seven years, Yuanshi first year, by Wang Mang killed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renyin day of the fourth month in Suihe 2. After seven years, in Yuanshi 1, he was killed by Wang Mang.

cells.content: 孔鄉侯傅晏
cells.literal: Kong Xiang Marquis Fu Yan
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Kongxiang: Fu Yan

cells.content: 以皇后父侯，三千戶，又益二千戶。
cells.literal: As empress's father made marquis, 3,000 households, again additional 2,000 households.
cells.idiomatic: As the empress's father he was made marquis with 3,000 households, with a further grant of 2,000 households.

cells.content: 四月壬寅封，六年，元壽二年，坐亂妻妾位免，徙合浦。
cells.literal: Fourth month renyin day enfeoffed, six years, Yuanshou second year convicted of disordering wives concubines ranks dismissed, relocated to Hepu.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the renyin day of the fourth month. After six years, in Yuanshou 2, he was convicted of disordering the ranks of wife and concubines, was dismissed, and was relocated to Hepu.

cells.content: 夏丘
cells.literal: Xia Qiu
cells.idiomatic: Xiaqiu

cells.content: 平周侯丁滿
cells.literal: Ping Zhou Marquis Ding Man
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Pingzhou: Ding Man

cells.content: 以帝舅子侯，千七百三十九戶。
cells.literal: As emperor's maternal uncle's son made marquis, 1,739 households.
cells.idiomatic: As the emperor's maternal uncle's son he was made marquis with a fief of 1,739 households.

cells.content: 五月己丑封，元始三年，坐非正免。
cells.literal: Fifth month jichou day enfeoffed, Yuanshi third year, convicted improper succession, dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the jichou day of the fifth month. In the third year of Yuanshi, he was convicted of improper succession and dismissed.

cells.content: 湖陽
cells.literal: Huyang.
cells.idiomatic: Huyang.

cells.content: 高樂節侯師丹
cells.literal: Gaole Jie Marquis Shi Dan.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie of Gaole: Shi Dan.

cells.content: 以大司馬關內侯侯，二千三十六戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Marshal marquis within the passes made marquis, two thousand thirty-six households.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Marshal, he was made marquis with a fief within the passes of 2,036 households.

cells.content: 綏和二年七月庚午封，一年，建平元年，坐漏泄免，元始三年二月癸巳更為義陽侯，二月薨。
cells.literal: Suhe second year seventh month gengwu day enfeoffed, one year, Jianping first year, convicted leaking dismissed, Yuanshi third year second month guisi day changed to Yiyang marquis, second month died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the gengwu day of the seventh month in the second year of Suhe. After one year, in the first year of Jianping, he was convicted of leaking [secrets] and dismissed. On the guisi day of the second month in the third year of Yuanshi he was re-created Marquis of Yiyang and died in the second month.

cells.content: 侯業嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Marquis Ye succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ye succeeded him. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished.

cells.content: 新野東海
cells.literal: Xinye, Donghai.
cells.idiomatic: Xinye, Donghai.

cells.content: 高武貞侯傅喜
cells.literal: Gaowu Zhen Marquis Fu Xi.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Zhen of Gaowu: Fu Xi.

cells.content: 以帝祖母皇太太后從父弟大司馬侯，二千三十戶。
cells.literal: As emperor's grandmother Grand Empress Dowager father's younger brother's son Grand Marshal marquis, two thousand thirty households.
cells.idiomatic: As the emperor's grandmother the Grand Empress Dowager's younger cousin and Grand Marshal, he was made marquis with 2,030 households.

cells.content: 建平元年正月丁酉封，十五年薨。
cells.literal: Jianping first year first month dingyou day enfeoffed, fifteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the first month in the first year of Jianping; died after fifteen years.

cells.content: 建國二年，侯勁嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Jianguo second year, Marquis Jin succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianguo, Marquis Jin succeeded him. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished.

cells.content: 杜衍
cells.literal: Duyan.
cells.idiomatic: Duyan.

cells.content: 楊鄉侯朱博
cells.literal: Yangxiang Marquis Zhu Bo.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yangxiang: Zhu Bo.

cells.content: 以丞相侯，二千五十戶，上書以故事不過千戶，還千五十戶。
cells.literal: As chancellor marquis, two thousand fifty households, memorialized that precedent did not exceed one thousand households, returned one thousand fifty households.
cells.idiomatic: As chancellor, he was made marquis with 2,050 households; he memorialized that precedent did not exceed 1,000 households, and 1,050 households were returned.

cells.content: 建平二年四月乙亥封，八月，坐誣罔，自殺。
cells.literal: Jianping second year fourth month yihai day enfeoffed, eighth month, convicted false accusation and deceit, committed suicide.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the yihai day of the fourth month in the second year of Jianping. In the eighth month he was convicted of false accusation and deceit and committed suicide.

cells.content: 湖陵
cells.literal: Huling.
cells.idiomatic: Huling.

cells.content: 新甫侯王嘉
cells.literal: Xinfu Marquis Wang Jia.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Xinfu: Wang Jia.

cells.content: 以丞相侯，千六十八戶。
cells.literal: As chancellor marquis, one thousand sixty-eight households.
cells.idiomatic: As chancellor, he was made marquis with 1,068 households.

cells.content: 三年四月丁酉封，三年，元壽元年，罔上，下獄瘐死。
cells.literal: Third year fourth month dingyou day enfeoffed, three years, Yuanshou first year, deceived throne, imprisoned died of illness in confinement.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the fourth month in the third year. After three years, in the first year of Yuanshou, he deceived the throne; he was imprisoned and died in confinement of illness.

cells.content: 元始四年，侯崇紹封，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Yuanshi fourth year, Marquis Chong continued enfeoffment, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanshi, Marquis Chong was re-enfeoffed to continue the line. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished.

cells.content: 新野
cells.literal: Xinye.
cells.idiomatic: Xinye.

cells.content: 汝昌侯傅商
cells.literal: Ruchang Marquis Fu Shang.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Ruchang: Fu Shang.

cells.content: 以皇太太后從父弟封，千戶，後以奉先侯祀益封，凡五千戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Empress Dowager father's younger brother's son enfeoffed, one thousand households, later for maintaining former marquis sacrifices additional enfeoffment, in all five thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As the Grand Empress Dowager's younger cousin, he was enfeoffed with 1,000 households; later, for maintaining the sacrifices to the former marquis, he received additional enfeoffment—in all 5,000 households.

cells.content: 四年二月癸卯封，一年，元壽元年，坐外附諸侯免。
cells.literal: Fourth year second month guimao day enfeoffed, one year, Yuanshou first year, convicted improper affiliation with regional lords dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the guimao day of the second month in the fourth year. After one year, in the first year of Yuanshou, he was convicted of improper affiliation with regional lords and dismissed.

cells.content: 元壽二年五月，侯昌以商兄子紹奉祀封，八月，坐非正免。
cells.literal: Yuanshou second year fifth month, Marquis Chang as Shang elder brother's son continued sacrifices enfeoffed, eighth month, convicted improper succession dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuanshou, Marquis Chang was enfeoffed as Shang's elder brother's son to continue the sacrifices. In the eighth month he was convicted of improper succession and dismissed.

cells.content: 陽穀
cells.literal: Yanggu.
cells.idiomatic: Yanggu.

cells.content: 陽新侯鄭業
cells.literal: Yangxin Marquis Zheng Ye.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yangxin: Zheng Ye.

cells.content: 以皇太太后同母弟子侯，千戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Empress Dowager same mother younger brother's son marquis, one thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As the Grand Empress Dowager's half-brother's son, he was made marquis with 1,000 households.

cells.content: 八月辛卯封，二年，元壽二年，坐非正免。
cells.literal: Eighth month xinmao day enfeoffed, two years, Yuanshou second year, convicted improper succession dismissed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the eighth month. After two years, in the second year of Yuanshou, he was convicted of improper succession and dismissed.

cells.content: 新野
cells.literal: Xinye.
cells.idiomatic: Xinye.

cells.content: 高安侯董賢
cells.literal: Gao'an Marquis Dong Xian.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Gao'an: Dong Xian.

cells.content: 以侍中駙馬都尉告東平王雲祝詛反逆侯，千戶，後益封，二千戶。
cells.literal: As Palace Attendant Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry reported Prince of Dongping Yun cursing plotting rebellion marquis, one thousand households, later additional enfeoffment, two thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As Palace Attendant and Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry, he reported the Prince of Dongping Yun's cursing and plotting rebellion and was made marquis with 1,000 households; later his fief was increased to 2,000 households.

cells.content: 建平四年八月辛卯封，二年，元壽二年，坐為大司馬不合眾心免，自殺。
cells.literal: Jianping fourth year eighth month xinmao day enfeoffed, two years, Yuanshou second year, convicted as Grand Marshal not according with popular sentiment dismissed, committed suicide.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the eighth month in the fourth year of Jianping. After two years, in the second year of Yuanshou, he was convicted as Grand Marshal of failing to accord with popular sentiment, was dismissed, and committed suicide.

cells.content: 朱扶
cells.literal: Zhufu.
cells.idiomatic: Zhufu.

cells.content: 方陽侯孫寵
cells.literal: Fangyang Marquis Sun Chong.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Fangyang: Sun Chong.

cells.content: 以騎都尉與息夫躬告東平王反謀侯，千戶。
cells.literal: As Commandant of Cavalry with Xi Fugong reported Prince of Dongping rebellion plot marquis, one thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As Commandant of Cavalry, together with Xi Fugong he reported the Prince of Dongping's rebellion plot and was made marquis with 1,000 households.

cells.content: 八月辛卯封，二年，元壽二年，坐前為姦讒免，徙合浦。
cells.literal: Eighth month xinmao day enfeoffed, two years, Yuanshou second year, convicted earlier slander dismissed, relocated to Hepu.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the eighth month. After two years, in the second year of Yuanshou, he was convicted of earlier slander and dismissed, and was relocated to Hepu.

cells.content: 龍亢
cells.literal: Longkang.
cells.idiomatic: Longkang.

cells.content: 宜陵侯息夫躬
cells.literal: Yiling Marquis Xi Fugong.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yiling: Xi Fugong.

cells.content: 以博士弟子因董賢告東平王反謀侯，千戶。
cells.literal: As Erudite student through Dong Xian reported Prince of Dongping rebellion plot marquis, one thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: A Erudite student who, through Dong Xian, reported the Prince of Dongping's rebellion plot and was made marquis with 1,000 households.

cells.content: 八月辛卯封，二年，元壽二年，坐祝詛，下獄死。
cells.literal: Eighth month xinmao day enfeoffed, two years, Yuanshou second year, convicted cursing, imprisoned died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the xinmao day of the eighth month. After two years, in the second year of Yuanshou, he was convicted of cursing [the emperor], was imprisoned, and died in jail.

cells.content: 杜衍
cells.literal: Duyan.
cells.idiomatic: Duyan.

cells.content: 長平頃侯彭宣
cells.literal: Changping Qing Marquis Peng Xuan.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Qing of Changping: Peng Xuan.

cells.content: 以大司空侯，二千七十四戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Minister of Works marquis, two thousand seventy-four households.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Minister of Works, he was made marquis with 2,074 households.

cells.content: 元壽二年五月甲子封，四年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanshou second year fifth month jiazi day enfeoffed, four years died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the jiazi day of the fifth month in the second year of Yuanshou; died after four years.

cells.content: 元始四年，節侯聖嗣，十四年薨。
cells.literal: Yuanshi fourth year, Jie Marquis Sheng succeeded, fourteen years died.
cells.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanshi, Jie Marquis Sheng succeeded him; died after fourteen years.

cells.content: 天鳳五年，侯業嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Tianfeng fifth year, Marquis Ye succeeded, Wang Mang defeated, extinct.
cells.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianfeng, Marquis Ye succeeded him. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished.

cells.content: 濟南
cells.literal: Jinan.
cells.idiomatic: Jinan.

sentences.zh: 右孝哀十三人。

translations.literal: Above: thirteen persons under Emperor Ai.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists thirteen persons enfeoffed under Emperor Ai.

sentences.zh: 新成、新都、平陽、營陵、德五人隨父，凡十八人。

translations.literal: The Marquises of Xincheng, Xindu, Pingyang, Yingling, and De — five persons listed with their fathers. In total, eighteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Five — the Marquises of Xincheng, Xindu, Pingyang, Yingling, and De — are listed with their fathers, for a total of eighteen persons.

cells.content: 扶德侯馬宮
cells.literal: Fude Marquis Ma Gong.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Fude: Ma Gong.

cells.content: 以大司徒侯，二千戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Minister of the Masses marquis, two thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Minister of the Masses, he was made marquis with 2,000 households.

cells.content: 元始元年二月丙辰封，王莽篡位，為太子師，卒官。
cells.literal: Yuanshi first year second month bingchen day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became Heir Apparent Tutor, died in office.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingchen day of the second month in the first year of Yuanshi. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Tutor to the Heir Apparent and died in office.

cells.content: 贛榆
cells.literal: Ganyu.
cells.idiomatic: Ganyu.

cells.content: 扶平侯王崇
cells.literal: Fuping Marquis Wang Chong.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Fuping: Wang Chong.

cells.content: 以大司空侯，二千戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Minister of Works marquis, two thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Minister of Works, he was made marquis with 2,000 households.

cells.content: 二月丙辰封，三年，為傅婢所毒，薨。
cells.literal: Second month bingchen day enfeoffed, three years, by tutor's maid poisoned, died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingchen day of the second month; after three years he was poisoned by a tutor's maid and died.

cells.content: 臨淮
cells.literal: Linhuai.
cells.idiomatic: Linhuai.

cells.content: 廣陽侯甄豐
cells.literal: Guangyang Marquis Zhen Feng.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Guangyang: Zhen Feng.

cells.content: 以左將軍光祿勳定策安宗廟侯，五千三百六十五戶。
cells.literal: As General of the Left Bearer of the Bright Insignia settled policy secured ancestral temples marquis, five thousand three hundred sixty-five households.
cells.idiomatic: As General of the Left and Bearer of the Bright Insignia, for settling the policy and securing the ancestral temples, he was made marquis with 5,365 households.

cells.content: 二月癸巳封，王莽篡位，為廣新公，後為王莽所殺。
cells.literal: Second month guisi day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became Guangxin Duke, later by Wang Mang killed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the guisi day of the second month. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Duke of Guangxin and was later killed by Wang Mang.

cells.content: 南陽
cells.literal: Nanyang.
cells.idiomatic: Nanyang.

cells.content: 承陽侯甄邯
cells.literal: Chengyang Marquis Zhen Han.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Chengyang: Zhen Han.

cells.content: 以侍中奉車都尉定策安宗廟功侯，二千四百戶。
cells.literal: As Palace Attendant Commandant of the Carriages settled policy secured ancestral temples merit marquis, two thousand four hundred households.
cells.idiomatic: As Palace Attendant and Commandant of the Carriages, for merit in settling the policy and securing the ancestral temples, he was made marquis with 2,400 households.

cells.content: 三月癸卯封，王莽篡位，為承新公。
cells.literal: Third month guimao day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became Chengxin Duke.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the guimao day of the third month. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Duke of Chengxin.

cells.content: 汝南
cells.literal: Runan.
cells.idiomatic: Runan.

cells.content: 褒魯節侯公子寬
cells.literal: Baolu Jie Marquis Gongzi Kuan.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie of Baolu: Gongzi Kuan.

cells.content: 以周公世魯頃公玄孫之玄孫奉周祀侯，二千戶。
cells.literal: As Duke of Zhou lineage Lu Duke Qing great-great-grandson's great-great-grandson maintained Zhou sacrifices marquis, two thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As a descendant of the Duke of Zhou—the great-great-grandson of Duke Qing of Lu's great-great-grandson—who maintained Zhou sacrifices, he was made marquis with 2,000 households.

cells.content: 六月丙午封，薨。
cells.literal: Sixth month bingwu day enfeoffed, died.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingwu day of the sixth month; died.

cells.content: 十一月，侯相如嗣，更姓公孫氏，後更為姬氏。
cells.literal: Eleventh month, Marquis Xiangru succeeded, changed surname to Gongsun clan, later changed to Ji clan.
cells.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Marquis Xiangru succeeded him; the surname was changed to Gongsun, and later to Ji.

cells.content: 南陽平
cells.literal: Nanyangping.
cells.idiomatic: Nanyangping.

cells.content: 褒成侯孔均
cells.literal: Baocheng Marquis Kong Jun.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Baocheng: Kong Jun.

cells.content: 以孔子世褒成烈君霸曾孫奉孔子祀侯，二千戶。
cells.literal: As Confucius lineage Baocheng Lord Lie Ba great-grandson maintained Confucius sacrifices marquis, two thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As a descendant of Confucius—the great-grandson of Lord Lie of Baocheng Ba—who maintained sacrifices to Confucius, he was made marquis with 2,000 households.

cells.content: 六月丙午封。
cells.literal: Sixth month bingwu day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingwu day of the sixth month.

cells.content: 瑕丘
cells.literal: Xiaqiu.
cells.idiomatic: Xiaqiu.

cells.content: 防鄉侯平晏
cells.literal: Fangxiang Marquis Ping Yan.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Fangxiang: Ping Yan.

cells.content: 以長樂少府與劉歆、孔永、孫遷四人使治明堂辟雍得萬國驩心功侯，各千戶。
cells.literal: As Chang Le Junior Steward with Liu Xin, Kong Yong, Sun Qian four men oversaw Bright Hall Imperial Academy obtained myriad states rejoicing merit marquis, each one thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As Chang Le Junior Steward, with Liu Xin, Kong Yong, and Sun Qian—four men who oversaw the Bright Hall and Imperial Academy and won the hearts of the myriad states—he was made marquis for merit, with 1,000 households.

cells.content: 五年閏月丁丑封，王莽篡位，為就新公。
cells.literal: Fifth year intercalary month dingchou day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became Jiuxin Duke.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingchou day of the intercalary month in the fifth year. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Duke of Jiuxin.

cells.content: 紅休侯劉歆
cells.literal: Hongxiu Marquis Liu Xin.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Hongxiu: Liu Xin.

cells.content: 以侍中犧和與平晏同功侯。
cells.literal: As Palace Attendant Harmonizer of Sacrifices with Ping Yan same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Palace Attendant and Harmonizer of Sacrifices, he was made marquis for the same merit as Ping Yan.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封，王莽篡位，為國師公，後為莽所誅。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became National Preceptor Duke, later by Mang executed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Duke of the National Preceptor and was later executed by Mang.

cells.content: 寧鄉侯孔永
cells.literal: Ningxiang Marquis Kong Yong.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Ningxiang: Kong Yong.

cells.content: 以侍中五官中郎將與平晏同功侯。
cells.literal: As Palace Attendant General of the Five Offices with Ping Yan same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Palace Attendant and General of the Five Offices, he was made marquis for the same merit as Ping Yan.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封，王莽篡位，為大司馬。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became Grand Marshal.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Grand Marshal.

cells.content: 定鄉侯孫遷
cells.literal: Dingxiang Marquis Sun Qian.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Dingxiang: Sun Qian.

cells.content: 以常侍謁者與平□同功侯。
cells.literal: As Regular Attendant Usher with Ping □ same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Regular Attendant and Usher, he was made marquis for the same merit as Ping [Yan].

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 常鄉侯王惲
cells.literal: Changxiang Marquis Wang Yun.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Changxiang: Wang Yun.

cells.content: 以太僕與閻遷、陳崇等八人使行風俗齊同萬國功侯，各千戶。
cells.literal: As Grand Master of the Stud with Yan Qian, Chen Chong and eight others toured customs harmonize myriad states merit marquis, each one thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Master of the Stud, with Yan Qian, Chen Chong, and eight others who toured customs to harmonize the myriad states, he was made marquis for merit, with 1,000 households.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 望鄉侯閻遷
cells.literal: Wangxiang Marquis Yan Qian.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Wangxiang: Yan Qian.

cells.content: 以鴻臚與王惲同功侯。
cells.literal: As Grand Herald with Wang Yun same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Grand Herald, he was made marquis for the same merit as Wang Yun.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 南鄉侯陳崇
cells.literal: Nanxiang Marquis Chen Chong.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Nanxiang: Chen Chong.

cells.content: 以大司徒司直與王惲同功侯。
cells.literal: As Grand Minister of the Masses Director with Wang Yun same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Director under the Grand Minister of the Masses, he was made marquis for the same merit as Wang Yun.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 邑鄉侯李翕
cells.literal: Yixiang Marquis Li Xi.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yixiang: Li Xi.

cells.content: 以水衡都尉與王惲同功侯。
cells.literal: As Superintendent of Waterways and Parks with Wang Yun same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Superintendent of Waterways and Parks, he was made marquis for the same merit as Wang Yun.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 亭鄉侯郝黨
cells.literal: Tingxiang Marquis Hao Dang.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Tingxiang: Hao Dang.

cells.content: 以中郎將與王惲同功侯。
cells.literal: As General of the Gentlemen with Wang Yun same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As General of the Gentlemen, he was made marquis for the same merit as Wang Yun.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 章鄉侯謝殷
cells.literal: Zhangxiang Marquis Xie Yin.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Zhangxiang: Xie Yin.

cells.content: 以中郎將與王惲同功侯。
cells.literal: As General of the Gentlemen with Wang Yun same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As General of the Gentlemen, he was made marquis for the same merit as Wang Yun.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 蒙鄉侯逯普
cells.literal: Mengxiang Marquis Lu Pu.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Mengxiang: Lu Pu.

cells.content: 以騎都尉與王惲同功侯。
cells.literal: As Commandant of Cavalry with Wang Yun same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Commandant of Cavalry, he was made marquis for the same merit as Wang Yun.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封，王莽篡位，為大司馬。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became Grand Marshal.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Grand Marshal.

cells.content: 盧鄉侯陳鳳
cells.literal: Luxiang Marquis Chen Feng.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Luxiang: Chen Feng.

cells.content: 以中郎將與王惲同功侯。
cells.literal: As General of the Gentlemen with Wang Yun same merit marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As General of the Gentlemen, he was made marquis for the same merit as Wang Yun.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 成武侯孫建
cells.literal: Chengwu Marquis Sun Jian.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Chengwu: Sun Jian.

cells.content: 以強奴將軍有折衝之威侯。
cells.literal: As Powerful Crossbows General had repulse-the-foe authority marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As General of the Powerful Crossbows, for having the authority to repulse the foe, he was made marquis.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封，王莽篡位，為成新公。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed, Wang Mang usurped throne, became Chengxin Duke.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, he became Duke of Chengxin.

cells.content: 明統侯侯輔
cells.literal: Mingtong Marquis Hou Fu.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Mingtong: Hou Fu.

cells.content: 以騎都尉明為人後一統之義侯。
cells.literal: As Commandant of Cavalry clarified adopting heir unify succession principle marquis.
cells.idiomatic: As Commandant of Cavalry, for clarifying the principle of adopting an heir to unify succession, he was made marquis.

cells.content: 閏月丁酉封。
cells.literal: Intercalary month dingyou day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the dingyou day of the intercalary month.

cells.content: 破胡侯陳馮
cells.literal: Pohu Marquis Chen Feng.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Pohu: Chen Feng.

cells.content: 以父湯前為副校尉討郅支單于侯，千四百戶。
cells.literal: As father Tang formerly Deputy Commandant attacked Zhizhi Chanyu marquis, one thousand four hundred households.
cells.idiomatic: As the son of Tang, who had earlier as Deputy Commandant attacked the Zhizhi Chanyu and was made marquis, he received 1,400 households.

cells.content: 七月丙申封。
cells.literal: Seventh month bingshen day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingshen day of the seventh month.

cells.content: 討狄侯杜勳
cells.literal: Taodi Marquis Du Xun.
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Taodi: Du Xun.

cells.content: 以前為軍假丞手斬郅支單于首侯，千戶。
cells.literal: Formerly as Army Deputy Director personally beheaded Zhizhi Chanyu head marquis, one thousand households.
cells.idiomatic: Who had earlier as Army Deputy Director personally beheaded the Zhizhi Chanyu and was made marquis with 1,000 households.

cells.content: 七月丙申封。
cells.literal: Seventh month bingshen day enfeoffed.
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on the bingshen day of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 孝平二十二人，邛成、博陵、宣平、紅、舞陽、秺、樂陵、都成、新甫、爰氏、合陽、義陽、章鄉、信成、隨桃、褒新、賞都十七人隨父繼世，凡三十九人。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Ping: twenty-two persons. The Marquises of Qiongcheng, Boling, Xuanping, Hong, Wuyang, Du, Leling, Ducheng, Xinfu, Yuanshi, Heyang, Yiyang, Zhangxiang, Xincheng, Suitao, Baoxin, and Shangdu — seventeen persons listed with their fathers and continuing the line. In total, thirty-nine persons.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Ping: twenty-two persons. Seventeen — the Marquises of Qiongcheng, Boling, Xuanping, Hong, Wuyang, Du, Leling, Ducheng, Xinfu, Yuanshi, Heyang, Yiyang, Zhangxiang, Xincheng, Suitao, Baoxin, and Shangdu — are listed with their fathers as continuations of the line, for a total of thirty-nine persons.
